images_research_notes: Extremely limited real-photo access this session despite exhaustive effort: (1) Instagram web_profile_info API returned a stub '{"status":"ok"}' with no data or an explicit 401 rate-limit ('Please wait a few minutes') on every attempt across ~2 hours of retries, both via direct curl and via a Jina Reader headless-render proxy; IG mirrors (imginn, picuki, pixwox, instanavigation, picnob) were all Cloudflare-blocked or 404/410. (2) Headless Chromium (Playwright) could not complete any HTTPS connection through this sandbox's egress proxy (ERR_CONNECTION_RESET on every domain tested, including example.com), so no client-rendered site could be screenshotted directly; a Jina Reader (r.jina.ai) headless-render proxy was used instead as a workaround and is what unlocked the Square booking menu and Google Maps data below. (3) Fresha/ClassPass listings for this business only carry generic stock placeholder imagery, not real photos. (4) Yelp and Google Images search were blocked by CAPTCHA/consent walls even via the Jina proxy. Net real, verified photographic assets recovered: one interior/reception photo from this business's Google Business Profile cover photo (gps-cs-s community photo tied directly to this exact Google Place ID), the brand's gold linework icon (from the Square seller-brand-assets CDN, tied to this business's Square merchant ID ML34S833SSBMD), and the same logo with wordmark (from this business's own TikTok avatar). No interior treatment-room photos, no staff/service action photos, and no additional gallery images could be sourced. The site was deliberately built with a light photo footprint (1 real hero/interior photo, reused once more at a different crop, plus the two real logo assets) rather than padding with unrelated stock or Pinterest images that turned up in generic image search.
